title: RPG Maker MV free trial crash

posts.author: SephirothTheGod
posts.body:
Hello, yesterday I downloaded the free trial of RPG Maker MV.
I installed it, but when I click on the "continue" button it appear the logo and then it crash.
Tried many things but did not fix the problem..

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
we can't really help without more details.
what are the things you tried?
There are many possible causes from an antivirus force-shutting down the suspected virus over wrong monitor assignment in multimonitor setups to wrong display drivers and many more

posts.author: SephirothTheGod
posts.body:
I tried to reinstall it, tried to redownloading it + reinstall, tried to see if was the antivirus, tried to update nvidia drivers...
Nothing changed
